answer: Sequential Pulse Taxation: each agent must submit a unique, signed work artifact (pulse) within a rolling window; the ledger records a hash atlas mapping every identity to its last artifact. An identity can only act after referencing the prior identity's unclaimed output, and that reference is single-use. Attackers must generate one distinct, verifiable artifact per identity per cycle, paying compute, signing, and the quill cost of unique content creation for each. Duplicate or reused artifacts invalidate the whole batch, so mass registration yields no leverage.
